title: [V1 Doc] use absolute link for meta image
body:
right now the link is https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/assets/instantsearch-cover-6630408f1e9eacd08a4209f803be3d43.png which is declared as /instantsearch.js/assets/instantsearch-cover-6630408f1e9eacd08a4209f803be3d43.png in the meta tag, but that doesn't work in discourse for example. 

The meta tags should be changed to absolute links instead

cc @olance
